title: [BUG]
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [X] Anthropic API
- Claude CLI version: 10.0.17
- Operating System: NixOS 25.05
- Terminal:  Alacritty

## Bug Description
Currently working on a project that frequently makes reference to TPM, but claude consistently thinks everything should be TMP.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Have a project that references TPM throughout the codebase
2. Use Claude Code for that codebase to do anything

## Expected Behavior
Correctly reference TPM

## Actual Behavior
Thinks all instances of TPM refer to tmp

## Additional Context

● Update(../Projects/nixos-deteministic-keys/packages/deterministic-keys-core/src/tmp/sealing.rs)
